# Collection One Is Not the Beginning — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-loc-ppmsca-44953
Voiceover: The sheet demonstrates a contract-shaped network of design, printing, manufacture, advertising, attribution, and distribution—even when the operative agreements are absent from the image.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division

Rights: Free to Use and Reuse / Library of Congress curated set

### 8–16s — B06-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · QUESTION — What is the collection testing?. Name the wearer, use, proposition, material problem, cultural reference, price assumption, and evidence that could disprove the premise. A debut without a question becomes inventory searching for a story.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — B06-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · PROTOTYPE — Which failures taught the work?. Preserve dated sketches, trial patterns, samples, fittings, substitutions, costs, and rejection reasons. These records show development without automatically deciding authorship or ownership.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — B06-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · RELATION — Who carries the first promise?. Record contributors, suppliers, workers, advisers, venues, buyers, and subjects with their actual role, compensation basis, consent, credit, approval, and correction route. Do not infer a relationship from a launch image.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — B06-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · RELEASE — What must be true before visibility?. Require finished objects, verified claims, documented rights, realistic fulfillment, accessible media, customer terms, crisis contacts, and an archive deposit. Publication is a governance decision, not the end of production.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S08
Voiceover: Personal Digital Archiving is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Library of Congress

Rights: Link and quote narrowly; check each downloadable resource before redistribution.
